newsitem.title: UK: O&M, JWT to combine media divisions by end 1998.
newsitem.headline: O&M, JWT to combine media divisions by end 1998.

text.p: Ogilvy & Mather and J. Walter Thompson, global advertising agencies owned by WPP Group Plc, plan to merge their media operations by the end of 1998, the head of Ogilvy & Mather in Britain said Monday.
But Tom Bury, chief executive and deputy chairman of Ogilvy & Mather in London, said the merger would only work well if it provided clients with added value and not simply greater volume.
"It will happen in calendar 1998 without a doubt," he said when asked about news reports predicting the two agencies would combine their media operations.
The media divisions of Ogilvy & Mather and J. Walter Thompson advise companies on where to spend their advertising budgets and then they book the advertising space.
Ogilvy & Mather and J. Walter Thompson are two of the biggest global networks and are among some 40 advertising and marketing services companies owned by WPP.
